posts.title: Egypt in Melbourne
posts.description: On the way to the market, there was a large billboard sized poster sign: "Egyptian Cultural Festival 17 to 18 November 2026: Coptic Orthodox Church." It stood out from the music gigs posters and state government advertising which was also pasted to the derelict industrial building walls on a main arterial road. posts.title: Merri Creek reflections
posts.description: Someone very thoughtfully secured a three seater metal A-frame swinging chair to a large tree on the banks of Merri Creek. The location is ideal. Bare rich earth shaded by mature eucalypts trees which naturally provide ease of access to the waterway allowing dogs to bathe, children to play and adults to watch and chat.
